((π)/(2))rad

(log)_(4)(x+2)−(log)_(4)(x−1)=0

munder(lim, x→1/2)((2(x)^(2)+3x−2)/(2x−1))

((f(x+h)−f(x))/(h))
(f)^(′)(x)=munder(lim, h→0)((f(x+h)−f(x))/(h))

P(x) denotes the population of a city at time x in years.

Find the derivatives of the following functions.

f(x)=ln(x+2)
